name: Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022
information: ## This is the FMC-Only competition of [Kewbz UK Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2022). #### As FMC is not being held at [Kewbz UK Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2022), this is your chance to become the UK's Fewest Moves Champion! The podiummers will be crowned during the awards ceremony the following week in Coventry* Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *\\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK FMC National Champion.* [![Kewbz](https://i.imgur.com/0ohbs0x.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)
